archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for local service trust)

header.style: Solid background (bg-[#0F4C81] or primary) z-50 to make the white logo pop. Sticky top.
header.elements: Palmer Logo on left, Navigation in center, large Phone CTA on right.

hero.background: Use hero_bg image with heavy gradient overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0F4C81]/95 via-[#0F4C81]/80 to-transparent
hero.content: Big H1, '24/7 Emergency Service Available • Mon–Sat 7am–7pm' badge, large primary phone CTA (Accent color), secondary buttons (Schedule Service, Free Estimate).

service_cards.style: Clean white cards with 1px border, subtle shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all. Internal padding p-6.
service_cards.icon_strategy: Use dual-tone aesthetic or lucide-react icons (blue for cooling, orange for heating).

form.style: Strict grid layout inside a clean card. Shadcn inputs with primary border focus.

footer.content: Palmer logo (white), 24/7 trust badge, phone, links, Service Areas list, Tradesmen credit line with T logo at bottom

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. e.g. data-testid="hero-phone-cta"

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-1 and shadow-lg on interactive cards
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for service cards and area grid
motion.buttons: Active scale down on click (active:scale-95 transition-transform)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Work Sans for headings and Manrope for body text.
Ensure header has background of primary blue (bg-primary) so the white Palmer HVAC logo pops, or use sticky glassmorphism over a dark section.
Form must have exactly 9 fields as specified and save to backend. Ensure Shadcn select is used for dropdowns.
Make the phone number (479-200-5421) extremely prominent in Header, Hero, and Footer.
Use lucide-react icons for service cards.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and form inputs.
